name: AI for Babies
description: Agent entrypoint for the AI for Babies B2B glossary. Lets external AI agents discover the product catalog, initiate purchases over HTTP 402, and retrieve paid deliverables machine-readably.

agent_id.description: Identifies the buying agent; agent_id or email is required.

concept.description: Concept slug; required when product_id is concept-explainer-api.

webhook_payload.description: Posted to the payments_webhook endpoint. Authenticated with X-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body> using PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

checkout.protocol: POST /api/agent/buy -> HTTP 402 Payment Required with payment instructions (programmatic settlement over x402/zeroclick/1f916), HTTP 200 with a Stripe hosted checkout URL (stripe_hosted), or HTTP 200 with an immediate delivery token (free sample)

guardrails.rate_limit: max 3 buy attempts per agent_id+IP per 10 minutes (HTTP 429)
guardrails.currency_note: Product prices are fixed in USD; the USD cap applies to programmatic (x402/zeroclick/1f916) settlement value per UTC day. Stripe hosted checkout is exempt (unlimited). Orders pushed over the cap settle as held_for_review (HTTP 403 on delivery) instead of paid.
